description: Security-relevant events (sign-in, sign-out, token-family revoke, MFA changes, admin actions) are recorded to a queryable audit log.

requirements.description: All security-relevant events must be written to a queryable audit log persisted in SQLite. Events include: sign-in (success/failure), sign-out, token-family revocation, MFA enrollment/change/removal, admin actions (role change, user disable), and account lockout. Each log entry must capture: timestamp, event type, actor identity, target identity, realm, IP address, and outcome. The log must be queryable by event type, user, realm, and time range.
requirements.title: Auth-Event Audit Log for Security-Relevant Events
